deadline.value: Apply by 1 December 2026 to be considered for the top scholarships; the final deadline is 15 February 2027.
deadline.quote: Applications Close December 01 2026 for our top scholarships | For all applicants, applications must be submitted by February 15 and all supporting documentation* received by March 15.

also.quote: September 2027 | International Applicants | Application Deadline15 February 2027

gre_subject.value: GRE General and Chemistry Subject scores are not mandatory but are advantageous.
gre_subject.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General and Subject (Chemistry or another applicable subject) test scores are not mandatory. | While it is advantageous to submit GRE test scores, it is not a requirement.

supervisor.value: Admission is by the department; you can list faculty of interest, and you arrange a group after the offer.
supervisor.quote: Listing faculty names is only intended for identifying fields of research of interest and can potentially facilitate connections with the faculty member once a prospective student has received their letter of admission.

also.quote: No commitment from a supervisor prior to applying is necessary, but contacting faculty members is encouraged.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student gets at least CAD 40,000 a year for the first four years, subject to satisfactory research and teaching.
funding.quote: All full-time students who begin a UBC-Vancouver Ph.D. program in Chemistry will receive a funding package of a minimum of $40,000 for each of the first four years of their program (contingent on satisfactory research and teaching performance).

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's (direct entry) or a master's; international applicants are strongly encouraged to apply for direct PhD entry.
entry_route.quote: UBC Chemistry strongly encourages all international applicants to apply for direct entry into our PhD program, as the number of admissions offered to international MSc applicants is very limited.

app_fee.value: International applicants pay CAD 60; the department pays the fee for domestic applicants.
app_fee.quote: Effective October 1, 2022, international applicants will be charged an application fee of $60 CDN; for domestic applicants, the fee is paid for by the department.

gre_general.value: Not mandatory, but submitting scores is advantageous.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General and Subject (Chemistry or another applicable subject) test scores are not mandatory.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 92 overall (23/22/23/22 sections) or 4.5 on the new 6-point scale.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum overall TOEFL score for graduate admission to the Department of Chemistry is 92 on the internet-based test with minimum component scores of 23, 22, 23 and 22

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each band.
ielts_min.quote: For IELTS, a minimum overall band score of 6.5 is required with a minimum score of 6.0 in each component of the academic IELTS test.

english_waiver.value: No test is needed if your post-secondary instruction was in English, but you must upload an institutional document confirming it.
english_waiver.quote: Note: English language proficiency scores are not required if the language of instruction in your country is English at the post-secondary level. | Please include an institutional document indicating as such with your application.

notes: Applicants are considered for the Four Year Fellowship. Admitted students arrange a research group after the offer.
